## Outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the one owning system/spec.

## Evidence

Record exact commands, revision/environment and pass/fail/skip results. Link visual, integration or operational evidence as applicable.

## Contracts and risks

Describe changed contracts and consumers, compatibility/rollback, deviations and unresolved findings. Explain declarations in the target's `.baseline/change.json` (per-project state).

## Delivery record

- [ ] Owning tracker is updated before push.
- [ ] Relevant approvals and operator gates have accurate evidence/status.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass; skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] No secrets, customer exports or unauthorized copied assets are included.
